sections.title: Diabetes risk assessment, Physical & Mental wellbeing check

fields.title: Do you have a parent, sibling and/or child diagnosed with Type 2 diabetes?
Have you ever been told by your doctor that you have high blood pressure (hypertension)?
On the average, how many days do you exercise per week in the last four weeks? (At least 30 minutes or more of medium physical activity such as brisk walking, stair climbing, etc.)
Did you smoke in the last 4 weeks?
options: Often, within ½ pack per day
Often, at least ½ pack per day

fields.title: Did you consume alcohol in the last 4 weeks? (40ml of alcohol equivalent to about 2 drinks of a liquor?

Is there a difference in your daily life diet in comparison with the recommended healthy diet* in the last 4 weeks.

*Healthy diet refers to: Adequate diet, discipline, different varieties. More fruits and vegetables, coarse grains, non-fat, low fat or dairy products; Adequate high cholesterol food, sugar and fried food. Less salt (5-6g/day).
How often do you drink sugary beverages? Examples of sugary beverages are soft drinks, fruit juice, yoghurt drinks, coffee, tea and bubble tea.
In the last 4 weeks, how many days was your sleep less than 6 hours?
options: More than 10 days, but seldom overnight
More than 10 days, and often overnight

fields.title:
In the last 6 months, your overall pressure* is?
*Pressure includes: family, marriage, love, economy, children's education, health, care for the elderly and so on.
In the last 6 months, your stress level at work is?
During the past 4 weeks, how much did your health problems affect your productivity while you were working?
